What to do when your IT vendor gets acquired

1) Request an immediate reduction in your agreement with the new vendor.. 20% would be a good start.

2) Get a clear roadmap of their plans for the previous vendors products. A 5 year roadmap would be good. Do hey have support plans for hardware/software, how often new versions will be released, what their schedule will be, when they will obsolete existing sw/hw and plans for migration.

2) Start a new RFP. Getting tied into a single vendor is usually ok, until the acquiring company has a similar product they will try to make you migrate to. If you're going to all that trouble, find a better vendor.

3) Identify key contacts within the previous vendor. Make sure they stay with you. If they leave, you're probably going to have problems soon.

4) Get everything in writing. No verbal or handshake agreements.

5) If the vendor has been acquired by Oracle or HP, make plans to migrate to another vendor as quickly as possible.
